doc.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024

chapter: Studio work and playing by ear
title: Randy Brecker says Wesley influenced him
summary: Asked about studio work, Wesley recalls Randy Brecker saying he incorporated Wesley's playing.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Well tell me about — does any of the studio work, like all these people you played with, I wonder if anything sticks out in your mind? Vanessa Williams, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Randy Brecker.
It just goes on and on and on.

Randy Brecker sticks out in my mind because you know what he said? And I find it hard to believe but he said that I influenced his playing. I said now how did I influence Randy Brecker? He’s one of the top bebop trumpet players in the world you know. And I influenced his playing you know. He told me that he would listen to my stuff and incorporate it into his stuff you know. And that was amazing to me. I didn’t realize that I would influence a great musician like Randy Brecker. But other musicians have told me the same thing. Because I don’t know what — I didn’t know what I was doing but it was sticking with a lot of people. You know? A lot of great musicians.
